slides.claim: FBG construction feeds a two-branch graph-level diagnosis path.
on_slide: FBG-SEANet: frequency-band graph construction and diagnosis
slides.speaker_notes: Walk through OCF and band subgraphs. In SEANet, the total graph feeds Input; Input branches to the energy-assisted module, which feeds the first GCN; first pooling branches to the second readout path, and both readout paths merge before Dense classification and five independent square class-output markers (second highlighted orange). The frequency axis points downward. State that the input graph icon, sensor glyphs and adjacency are schematic. The author-lab figure labels both readout blocks IR layer while the public abstract uses SR; this discrepancy remains unresolved.

slides.claim: The redraw preserves method topology while leaving numerical adjacency unasserted.
slides.speaker_notes: The v7.5 composite has 18 source-visible directed routes checked against the publisher graphical abstract: five in the frequency-band panel, one Total graph-to-Input connection, and twelve in the SEANet diagnosis panel. The redraw uses vector sensor stand-ins and schematic graph coordinates; it does not claim a numerical adjacency matrix. CI verifies editable objects, route geometry, labels and rendering, but does not establish independent scientific approval, real projection/final-size readability, or a PowerPoint 2016 host round trip. These three checks remain open.
